pages.text: A $(bold)clock$() is anything that toggles on its own — a repeater loop, a hopper-comparator timer, an $(bold)Observer$() staring at a block it helps move.$(br2)An $(bold)Observer$() emits a one-tick pulse whenever the block it faces $(italic)changes$() — the simplest, most reliable pulse source in vanilla.
pages.title: Clocks

pages.text: Need a clean single pulse from a long press? That's a $(bold)pulse shaper$(). Vanilla does it with a torch and a repeater; $(italic)More Red$() packages it as the $(l:4_logic/timing)Pulse Gate$().
pages.title: Pulses
